---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible code or configuration problem
---

## Problem

Describe expected and observed behavior.

## Reproduction

Provide the commit, runner, configuration path, command and minimal synthetic example.
Include Python/package versions and a relevant error excerpt.

## Scientific context

State the season, test year, temporal mode, engine and affected manuscript/supplement item if relevant.
Do not attach collision records, restricted data, credentials or confidential paths.
